open_points.subject: correct_expense
open_points.text: - correct_expense: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: The required audit write has an occurred_at timestamp, but append_audit accepts neither the single instant nor an AuditIntent containing a timestamp; must append_audit accept the instant, must AuditIntent gain a timestamp field, or is the audit timestamp excluded from “every timestamp it writes”?
